item.name: Figure
item.encounter: The Library at Door 50 and the Electrical Room at Door 100 in The Hotel; Figure rooms in The Mines.
item.tell: Heavy footsteps and floor vibrations. Figure is blind.
item.behavior: Patrols key rooms and follows sound.
item.damage: Instant death on contact.
item.counter: Crouch and move quietly. Hide if it gets close, then finish the room puzzle without making noise.
item.cardSummary: A blind hunter that makes noise dangerous in the Library, the Electrical Room, and its Mines rooms.

item.name: Seek
item.encounter: Guaranteed chase sequences in The Hotel, plus an altered chase and Dam encounter in The Mines.
item.tell: Eyes appear on walls and black slime shows before the chase.
item.behavior: Chases through marked rooms and changes form in The Mines.
item.damage: Instant death if caught; chase obstacles can also hurt.
item.counter: Follow the blue path, keep running, and crouch or slide under obstacles.
item.cardSummary: A set-piece chase entity. The route matters more than fighting it, especially when the Mines change the chase.

item.name: Rush
item.encounter: A random room event during normal progression.
item.tell: Lights flicker, then a roar grows louder. Earthquakes can warn you in The Mines.
item.behavior: Speeds through rooms and breaks the lights as it passes.
item.damage: Instant death if it reaches you outside a hiding spot.
item.counter: Hide in a closet, bed, or locker and wait until the sound has passed.
item.cardSummary: The classic lights-flicker warning. Find a hiding spot before the roar reaches the room.

item.name: Ambush
item.encounter: A random room event during normal progression.
item.tell: The lights flicker and a loud warning sound approaches.
item.behavior: Rushes through the rooms several times instead of making one pass.
item.damage: Instant death if it reaches you outside a hiding spot.
item.counter: Hide, leave the hiding spot after it passes, and re-enter when it comes back.
item.cardSummary: Rush with extra passes. A closet is useful, but staying inside for every pass can trigger Hide.

item.name: Screech
item.encounter: Dark rooms, especially when the room has little or no light.
item.tell: A quiet “pst” comes from nearby.
item.behavior: Latches onto the player and attacks if it is not found quickly.
item.damage: Repeated damage if you fail to find it in time.
item.counter: Turn toward the sound and find Screech before it bites.
item.cardSummary: A dark-room check. Listen for the small “pst” and look around before the bite lands.

item.name: Eyes
item.encounter: A random appearance in a room or hallway.
item.tell: A purple glow and a cluster of eyes appear ahead.
item.behavior: Damages players who look directly at it.
item.damage: 10 damage when you look at it.
item.counter: Look away and keep your view on the floor or the route ahead.
item.cardSummary: The answer is counterintuitive: the glowing eyes are safe when you refuse to stare at them.

item.name: Halt
item.encounter: A dark hallway after a flicker event.
item.tell: A blue-lit hallway and the “Turn Around” prompt signal the encounter.
item.behavior: Forces a forward-and-back path while Halt appears behind you.
item.damage: 60 damage on contact.
item.counter: Follow the Turn Around prompt and switch direction whenever it appears.
item.cardSummary: A hallway puzzle with one instruction worth obeying: turn around when the game tells you to.

item.name: Dupe
item.encounter: A room with a duplicate numbered door.
item.tell: Two doors show different numbers, and the sequence no longer feels right.
item.behavior: Attacks when the player opens the wrong numbered door.
item.damage: Health damage varies by run settings.
item.counter: Check the last correct number and open only the next door in sequence.
item.cardSummary: A number-check trap. Slow down at a duplicate door instead of trusting the first label you see.

item.name: Hide
item.encounter: After staying in a hiding spot too long.
item.tell: A red screen, a “GET OUT” warning, and a heartbeat appear.
item.behavior: Ejects the player and blocks the hiding spot for a short time.
item.damage: The Hotel: 40 damage after staying too long. The Mines: failed heart checks can eject you and deal damage.
item.counter: Leave and re-enter the hiding spot when the warning appears. In The Mines, follow the heart-check rhythm.
item.cardSummary: Hiding is useful until it is not. Watch for the warning and do not let a closet become its own trap.

item.name: Dread
item.encounter: A room that has taken too long to clear.
item.tell: A clock or time-pressure cue warns that the room is no longer safe.
item.behavior: Closes in while the player delays in the room.
item.damage: Instant death if it catches you.
item.counter: Keep the route moving and leave the room before the time pressure expires.
item.cardSummary: A punishment for dawdling. If the room starts feeling like a waiting room, it is time to leave.

item.name: Snare
item.encounter: Greenhouse grass in The Hotel and grassy paths in The Outdoors.
item.tell: Small holes or plant spots blend into the ground.
item.behavior: Roots the player in place and interrupts movement.
item.damage: Damage and a brief stun.
item.counter: Watch the ground and use a light source to spot the holes before stepping on them.
item.cardSummary: A floor hazard with a name. Scan the grass before sprinting, especially in the Greenhouse.

item.name: Sally
item.encounter: A random appearance through Hotel windows.
item.tell: A window breaks and a heartbeat warns that Sally is close.
item.behavior: Chases the player and can steal an item before leaving.
item.damage: Non-lethal health damage and a maximum-health reduction.
item.counter: Give or drop an item when Sally demands one, or use a Crucifix if the chase becomes unsafe.
item.cardSummary: The window visitor formerly called Window. Keep a spare item ready if you do not want to lose something important.

item.name: Jack
item.encounter: Rarely appears in closets or behind numberless doors.
item.tell: A sudden face fills the hiding spot or doorway.
item.behavior: Creates a jumpscare but does not attack the player.
item.counter: Recover from the scare and continue the room.
item.cardSummary: A rare red face that wants your attention, not your health bar.

item.name: Timothy
item.encounter: A rare drawer encounter.
item.tell: A spider jumps out when a drawer is opened.
item.behavior: Bites once, then disappears.
item.damage: 5 damage.
item.counter: Close the drawer and keep searching.
item.cardSummary: The drawer spider. It is more startling than dangerous, but the bite still costs a little health.

item.name: Shadow
item.encounter: A rare appearance after a door or flicker event.
item.tell: A dark shape and a sharp shriek appear for a moment.
item.behavior: Shows up briefly and disappears without attacking.
item.counter: Let the jumpscare pass and keep moving.
item.cardSummary: A blink-and-you-miss-it scare. Shadow is dramatic, but not a threat to your run.

item.name: Jeff
item.encounter: Jeff Shop in The Hotel after the Library and the Jeff Shop in The Mines.
item.tell: Glowing eyes and a stocked shop mark Jeff's counter.
item.behavior: Sells supplies for Gold.
item.counter: Save Gold for the tool that fits the next section instead of spending it all at once.
item.cardSummary: Your friendly shopkeeper in two released areas. Jeff turns spare Gold into a little more breathing room.

item.name: El Goblino
item.encounter: At Jeff Shop in The Hotel and The Mines.
item.tell: El Goblino sits near the shop and starts a conversation.
item.behavior: Provides friendly dialogue and harmless reactions.
item.counter: Interact if you want the dialogue, then return to the route.
item.cardSummary: The shop's chatty goblin. El Goblino is a lore stop, not another thing to hide from.

item.name: Bob
item.encounter: At Jeff Shop in The Hotel and The Mines.
item.tell: Bob is seated near the shop.
item.behavior: Stays friendly and does not harm players.
item.counter: Interact if you want the dialogue, then continue shopping or exploring.
item.cardSummary: A quiet shop regular. Bob looks spooky, but this skeleton is on your side.

item.name: Grumble
item.encounter: The Nest around Door 150 and nearby Mines routes.
item.tell: A giant Giggle-like creature patrols the area and makes the route feel unsafe.
item.behavior: Patrols, chases, and pressures players through narrow tunnels.
item.damage: Lethal after repeated hits.
item.counter: Use narrow tunnels, lockers, and a light-based distraction to break its route when needed.
item.cardSummary: The Mines' large patrol threat. Keep the route tight and use light or cover to buy space.

item.name: Queen Grumble
item.encounter: A late Mines chase through the Caverns, Nest, or Sewage Cells.
item.tell: The larger Grumble appears as the chase route opens through the tunnels.
item.behavior: Chases players through the late Mines route.
item.damage: Instant death if caught during the chase.
item.counter: Keep moving, use narrow safe routes, and do not stop to search during the chase.
item.cardSummary: The late-run Grumble chase. Treat it like a route test: movement and clean turns matter most.

item.name: Giggle
item.encounter: Ceilings and tunnels in The Mines.
item.tell: A quiet laugh and a face cling to the ceiling above the route.
item.behavior: Drops onto the player's face and bites until it is removed.
item.damage: Damage continues while it clings.
item.counter: Look up before walking under a ceiling with Giggle and dislodge it quickly if it lands.
item.cardSummary: The ceiling check in The Mines. A quick glance upward can save a long chunk of health.

item.name: Gloombats
item.encounter: Dark rooms and nests in The Mines.
item.tell: A moth-like swarm gathers around a carried light.
item.behavior: Attacks lights and repeatedly bites players who stay near the swarm.
item.damage: 10 damage per attack.
item.counter: Turn off ordinary lights, use a Gloomstick or Laser Pointer, and move away from the swarm.
item.cardSummary: A lighting problem with wings. Put away the wrong light and keep moving through the dark.

item.name: Louie
item.encounter: Holes in the walls of The Mines.
item.tell: A rat-like face or hand appears in a wall hole.
item.behavior: Barters a dropped item for another item of similar value.
item.counter: Drop only an item you are willing to trade, then check what Louie gives back.
item.cardSummary: A Mines barter encounter. Louie can help, but only if you are comfortable giving up the item you drop.

item.name: Blitz
item.encounter: Random rooms in The Backdoor.
item.tell: A warning sound signals a fast approach.
item.behavior: Rushes through the rooms and can make more than one pass.
item.damage: Instant death on contact.
item.counter: Hide in a closet before it arrives and stay hidden until the attack is over.
item.cardSummary: The Backdoor's fast pass threat. Find a closet early and do not assume one pass means the room is safe.

item.name: Lookman
item.encounter: Random rooms in The Backdoor.
item.tell: A low rumble and glowing eyes signal its presence.
item.behavior: Attacks when the player looks at its eyes, then teleports away after the hit.
item.damage: 20 damage.
item.counter: Keep your view down and avoid eye contact while moving through the room.
item.cardSummary: The Backdoor version of the eye-contact test. Look at the floor and let it teleport away.

item.name: Haste
item.encounter: The Backdoor timer when the player fails to keep it running.
item.tell: The timer expires, a red haze appears, and Haste can be seen approaching through walls.
item.behavior: Approaches from behind when the timer runs out.
item.damage: Instant death when Haste catches the player.
item.counter: Pull the Timer Lever before the timer expires and keep moving between levers.
item.cardSummary: The Backdoor's timer enforcer. The safest Haste counter is routine: find the next lever before the clock wins.

item.name: A-60
item.encounter: After room A-060 in The Rooms.
item.tell: Static, crackling, or a fast approaching sound warns of the attack.
item.behavior: Charges through the rooms at high speed.
item.damage: 125 damage.
item.counter: Get into a locker as soon as the warning starts and wait for the sound to pass.
item.cardSummary: A-60 is the Rooms sprint check. When the static starts, the locker matters more than one extra room.

item.name: A-90
item.encounter: After room A-090, sometimes alongside other Rooms entities.
item.tell: A face or stop-sign-like warning appears on screen.
item.behavior: Freezes active entities and punishes player movement during the stop window.
item.damage: 90 damage.
item.counter: Stop all movement and input until the warning clears.
item.cardSummary: The Rooms' stop-input test. Do absolutely nothing until A-90 is finished doing it for you.

item.name: A-120
item.encounter: After room A-120 in The Rooms.
item.tell: Static and a deep drumming sound approach from the route ahead.
item.behavior: Charges through the room and can rebound from the far side.
item.damage: Instant death if caught.
item.counter: Hide in a locker after the cue and wait until the drumming ends.
item.cardSummary: A fast Rooms entity with a rebound trick. Wait for the sound to finish before leaving cover.

item.name: Bramble
item.encounter: The Hedge Maze in The Outdoors.
item.tell: Its lamp turns on and off as it patrols the maze.
item.behavior: Attacks players who move while its light is on and stops when the light is off.
item.damage: Damage depends on the attack state.
item.counter: Stop moving while Bramble's light is on and use a Lantern to read the maze when it is safe.
item.cardSummary: A light-and-movement puzzle in the Hedge Maze. Let Bramble's lamp decide when your feet move.

item.name: Eyestalk
item.encounter: The main chase route in The Outdoors.
item.tell: Eyes appear on trees and a chase cutscene starts.
item.behavior: Chases the player through an Outdoors route like a Seek sequence.
item.damage: Instant death if caught.
item.counter: Run the marked route, avoid Snares, and use a speed boost only when a turn or obstacle needs it.
item.cardSummary: An Outdoors chase with tree eyes and familiar Seek-style pressure. Keep the route clean and keep running.

item.name: Groundskeeper
item.encounter: Garden sheds and grass areas in The Outdoors.
item.tell: A grass warning, grunt, and the Groundskeeper's tools signal danger.
item.behavior: Protects the grass, attacks trespassers, and can kill hostile entities.
item.damage: Fatal if you remain on the grass after the warning.
item.counter: Step off the grass and use buildings or clear paths when the warning begins.
item.cardSummary: The garden's rule-enforcer. The grass is not a shortcut when the Groundskeeper tells you to leave it.

item.name: Mandrake
item.encounter: Holes and grass in The Outdoors.
item.tell: A mandrake can be pulled from the ground, then screams and darkens the player's view.
item.behavior: Keeps screaming near the player until it is replanted or carried away from danger.
item.damage: Can kill you if you stay near it too long.
item.counter: Replant it quickly or let the Groundskeeper deal with it, then move away from the scream.
item.cardSummary: A useful plant with an unpleasant voice. Replant Mandrake before the scream becomes the whole run.

item.name: Monument
item.encounter: Gardens and paths in The Outdoors.
item.tell: A cracked, vine-covered monument is followed by footsteps when it moves.
item.behavior: Moves when it is not being watched and closes in behind the player.
item.damage: Instant death if it catches you.
item.counter: Keep Monument in sight and look back before taking long turns away from it.
item.cardSummary: The statue that walks when you stop looking. Line of sight is the safest lock on Monument.

item.name: Surge
item.encounter: Open Outdoors areas during green lightning.
item.tell: The sky turns green and lightning or a loud scream warns of the storm.
item.behavior: Damages players who stay outside shelter during the storm.
item.damage: Damage over time while exposed.
item.counter: Get inside a closet, building, or other shelter before the storm reaches you.
item.cardSummary: An outdoor weather check. Green skies mean the route is over for now; find a roof.

item.name: Caws
item.encounter: Forest areas in The Outdoors.
item.tell: Crows take off and call from nearby trees.
item.behavior: Warns the player that another Outdoors threat is close.
item.counter: Watch where the flock moves and prepare for the threat it is pointing out.
item.cardSummary: The forest warning system. When the crows scatter, take the hint and check your surroundings.

item.name: Grampy
item.encounter: The Mill in The Outdoors.
item.tell: Grampy waits with a basket for a petal trade.
item.behavior: Trades eight Lotus Petals for a Lotus.
item.counter: Bring eight Lotus Petals before visiting The Mill.
item.cardSummary: The Mill's friendly trader. Count your petals before making the trip.

item.name: Guiding Light
item.encounter: Dark rooms, puzzles, chases, and death screens in the main floors.
item.tell: A blue glow highlights useful doors, keys, paths, and puzzle objects.
item.behavior: Guides the player and adds short tips to difficult moments.
item.counter: Follow the blue marks and check highlighted objects before guessing.
item.cardSummary: The blue helper for the main floors. If a key or route is easy to miss, Guiding Light usually points it out.

item.name: Curious Light
item.encounter: Death screens, subfloor guidance, and rift-related moments.
item.tell: A yellow star-like glow or rift appears during the explanation.
item.behavior: Explains deaths, guides exits, and offers less direct help than Guiding Light.
item.counter: Use the highlighted exit or key and read the short guidance before trying the section again.
item.cardSummary: The wider guide across released floors and subfloors. Curious Light helps explain what just went wrong.

item.name: Glitch
item.encounter: A room fails to load, the player goes out of bounds, or the player falls too far behind.
item.tell: Screen glitches and purple cubes appear around the player.
item.behavior: Teleports the player to a safe loaded room or back to the group.
item.counter: Stay on the loaded route and let the teleport finish if Glitch appears.
item.cardSummary: The emergency reset button of DOORS. Glitch usually means the level needs help, not that you should fight.

item.name: Void
item.encounter: A multiplayer run when one player falls too far behind the group.
item.tell: The straggling player is pulled away as the group gets far ahead.
item.behavior: Teleports the player back toward the rest of the team.
item.counter: Stay near the group so the teleport is not needed.
item.cardSummary: The team-distance failsafe for the main floors. Keep up and Void stays mostly theoretical.

item.name: World Lotus
item.encounter: The Courtyard, Jeff Shop, Rooms rebirth moments, and the main Outdoors encounter.
item.tell: A giant lotus and vine-covered form marks the encounter.
item.behavior: Controls or mimics entities. It is passive in some areas and hostile in The Outdoors.
item.damage: Does not directly damage players; controlled entities can.
item.counter: Use the rules for the controlled entity and follow the area's route instead of approaching the lotus.
item.cardSummary: The strange lotus behind several entity rules. Its danger depends on the area and what it is controlling.

item.name: RNIUSHCg==
item.encounter: After activating a Glitch Fragment.
item.tell: The screen glitches and a familiar Rush-style cue begins.
item.behavior: Uses a Rush-like charge with a possible rebound through the route.
item.damage: 100 damage.
item.counter: Hide like you would for Rush and wait until the route is clear.
item.cardSummary: The coded Rush variant. A Glitch Fragment is the trigger, so treat the first charge like Rush.

item.name: AR0xMBUSH
item.encounter: After activating a Glitch Fragment.
item.tell: The screen glitches and an Ambush-style warning begins.
item.behavior: Uses a harder Ambush-like attack with repeated passes.
item.counter: Hide and re-enter your hiding spot like you would for Ambush, then wait for every pass.
item.cardSummary: The coded Ambush variant. Give it the same respect as Ambush, with extra caution around repeated passes.

item.name: SCJVEREECH
item.encounter: After activating a Glitch Fragment.
item.tell: The screen glitches and multiple Screech-like cues can appear.
item.behavior: Uses a Screech-like swarm with more targets to check.
item.counter: Turn toward each Screech cue and react quickly before the next bite.
item.cardSummary: The coded Screech variant. Scan every “pst” instead of assuming the first one was the only target.
